labels.reason: Body cells provide species-specific Km, Vmax and Vmax/Km for meropenem and comparator imipenem. IN_VITRO_CLEARANCE classifies the in vitro metabolic evidence; these enzyme kinetics are explicitly not PK. DR001 is supported by the separate drug columns and comparator note. DR003 and DR004 are supported for source location, printed parameter values, units and in vitro identity, with experimental-unit details and uncertainty unresolved. DR012 has candidate mechanistic supporting evidence only: this item does not establish in vivo renal elimination, a physiological bridge or qualified translation inputs. DR024 is supported only for the statement that the human row is held separately; release authorization and freezes are not established. Preserve Rabbi and the flagged rhesus monkey values as printed.

findings.reason: Species-specific renal DHP-I enzyme kinetics are available as candidate mechanistic evidence. This page explicitly says they are not PK and does not establish in vivo renal elimination, body-size relationships, protein binding, supported animal-model outputs, physiological bridging assumptions or translation uncertainty.
findings.needed_material: Independent coverage review of this limited mechanistic contribution and separately supported translation inputs. Any proposed physiological bridge requires its own traceable justification under DR005.
